missed_audit_job.name: crypto-paper-forward-missed-audit
missed_audit_job.safety: Audit-only: no market fetch, signal generation, equity snapshot, execution, or backdated trade

publication_note: Portable static source contract; runtime deployment observations remain local. Historical scheduler-state changes remain visible in ordinary Git history, while sealed baseline hash commitments remain untouched.
scheduler_design: All deterministic jobs are Hermes no-agent scripts. Weekly launches may retry inside Monday 00:05-00:20 UTC after transient or pre-execution failure; DB schedule idempotency and the global writer lock prevent duplicate committed trades. The 00:21 audit records missed windows without market access or trading. Wrapper paths and hashes are checked against installed copies. The laptop must be powered on and the interactive user session available; this is not high-availability infrastructure.

windows_task_scheduler_watchdog.trigger: logon plus every 15 minutes for one day
